[RB-RAN-UPGRADE-REGRESSION#02] RAN software upgrade regression > Signature in the data: A software upgrade change on a site or group of sites, executed at night. A short availability dip during the restart is expected, typically one or two steps. Persistent quality loss after the restart. Elevated `drop_rate_pct`, lower `rrc_success_pct`, and sometimes a lower volume that does not recover on the following days. ... Version-specific. ... Repeated restarts....
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#02] Bad change and configuration regression > Signature in the data: A change record. In the change log, a `config_push` or `parameter_tuning` row on an aggregation router (which affects every site below it) or on each site of a group. Its status later reads `rolled_back`. The description can be bland, such as "scheduled parameter optimisation batch", so do not judge it by its wording. A step at the change time. ... What stays normal. ....
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#05] Bad change and configuration regression > Verification steps: 1. `get_anomalies` for `rrc_success_pct` and `drop_rate_pct` on a set of sites; read the start time. 2. `get_topology`: find the common ancestor of the affected sites (aggregation router or link). 3. ... 4. `query_kpis`: confirm availability is 100 % and the RRC step is aligned with the change. Use sites outside the changed subtree as a control group; they must be normal. 5. ...
[RB-RF-INTERFERENCE#03] RF interference > Differential diagnosis: Versus a bad change A configuration regression is a clean step at the time of a change record, over a whole router or site group. Interference has no change record, hits individual sectors, and follows time of day. Versus congestion ... Versus backhaul degradation ... DNS trouble is nationwide and leaves RRC success unaffected. Interference lowers RRC success locally. ...

# Call setup failures and dropped sessions at S-SAH-005 due to bad configuration push

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SAH-01`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of a config change on the parent aggregation router at 02:59 matches the exact KPI degradation onset across multiple downstream sites at 03:00. Alternative causes such as maintenance, external events, and other changes were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-22 03:00 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-22 02:59
- **Affected:** S-SAH-005, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-008

## Summary

A configuration push (CHG-2026-0057) of parameter template OPT-17 to aggregation router AGG-SAH-01 at 02:59 caused RRC failure rate increases and dropped sessions across multiple sites including S-SAH-005.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose at S-SAH-005 and peer sites starting at 2026-09-22 03:00 following a bad configuration change. Although a rollback was applied via CHG-2026-0058 at 2026-09-22 09:57, full recovery was ongoing or incomplete within the observation window.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-22 02:59: Config push CHG-2026-0057 executed on AGG-SAH-01 [CHG-2026-0057]
- 2026-09-22 03:00: Earliest KPI deviation onset with rrc_success_pct dropping and drop_rate_pct spiking across sites including S-SAH-005 [T7, ANM-000298, ANM-000299, ALR-0024]
- 2026-09-22 03:17: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SAH-001 [ALM-000489]
- 2026-09-22 03:28: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SAH-008 [ALM-000491]
- 2026-09-22 03:35: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SAH-005 [ALM-000492]
- 2026-09-22 09:57: Rollback change CHG-2026-0058 executed on AGG-SAH-01 [CHG-2026-0058]

## Evidence

- Detector alert and anomaly records show ongoing rrc_success_pct drop and drop_rate_pct spike starting at 2026-09-22 03:00 on S-SAH-005 and peer sites. [T1, T7, ALR-0024, ANM-000298, ANM-000299]
- A configuration push (CHG-2026-0057) was executed on parent aggregation router AGG-SAH-01 at 02:59 on 2026-09-22, pushing parameter template OPT-17. [T4, T6, CHG-2026-0057]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes and their ancestors. [T5]
- No external events were recorded for region SAH during the incident window. [T9]
- A rollback of the configuration change was performed via CHG-2026-0058 at 2026-09-22 09:57. [CHG-2026-0058]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SAH-01: confirmed. The configuration push CHG-2026-0057 on AGG-SAH-01 directly preceded the KPI degradation onset across downstream sites at 03:00, perfectly fitting the signature in RB-BAD-CHANGE#02. [CHG-2026-0057, T7, RB-BAD-CHANGE#02]
2. **planned_maintenance**: rejected. No maintenance window was scheduled on the nodes or their ancestors during the time window. [T5]
3. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-B: rejected. Topology and alarms show no fiber link failure, and anomalies correlate strictly with the configuration change time. [T2, T3, CHG-2026-0057]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0058: This change was the rollback action executed subsequent to the incident to undo CHG-2026-0057, not the cause of the degradation.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor KPIs following the rollback (CHG-2026-0058) to ensure complete restoration of RRC success rates and drop rates.
- Review parameter template OPT-17 settings before any future deployment on aggregation routers.
